title: Prag – Weseli-Mez. – (Budweis – Salzburg) – Gmünd – Wien und zurück (Auszugsweise)
notes: Winter 1913/14, p. 179 (page_seq 183), printed sideways: turned a quarter turn plus 0.5 deg (the rules are then straight within 1 px). As in the summer layout, one station column in the middle: p1 holds the ten down columns left of it (c0-c9, read top to bottom), p2 the ten up columns right of it (c10-c19, read bottom to top). c0 includes the strip with the sideways note "D-Zug Berlin-Prag-Triest (Speisewagen Prag-Wien)" beside that train's times, so a note keyed c:0 belongs to that train. Rows: r0 a. Dresd. Hbf., r1 Bodenb., r2 the classes line and "D-Zug Triest-Prag-Berl." (header band, skipped), r3 a. Prag (F.J.B.), r4 the stations Nusle to Gmünd (skipped), r5 Wien F.J.B.; each panel's row lines follow its own times (the right half sits 3-5 px higher). Footnote boxes: p1 the left margin (the "Ausserdem mit II. u. III. Kl." Prag-Beneschau-Tabor trains and the note "§ Nur Dienstag, Samstag, Sonn- und Festtag." printed beside table 124), p2 the right margin ("Ausserdem" Beneschau-Prag trains and "◗ Über Wschetat-Priwor-Tetschen."). Table 124 (lower half of the page) is not laid out.
